### The Body of Divinity in Miniature - Truth For Life - October 22
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-october-22-2019.html
Passage: Hosea 14:4
Points:
- God's declaration to love freely summarizes the heart of the Christian gospel.
- Divine love flows spontaneously toward those who could never earn, buy, or deserve it.
- The covenant of grace requires no prerequisite fitness or worthiness on our part.
- Struggling with spiritual coldness or inadequate feelings does not void God's promise.
- This lavish assurance of pardon and healing lovingly urges backsliders to return to Him.
